title: Continuous Process-Level Evaluation for Evolving Enterprise AI Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2610.01833v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise AI agent skills evolve as tool APIs, models, and specifications change, yet final-output evaluation can miss process-level behavioral drift. We present a continuous evaluation framework combining outcome-level and process-level checks, applied to Revenue and Productivity variants of a Business Value Determination skill in an enterprise Value Aware Resiliency system. The framework independently computes per-run ground truth, materializes reusable template tests, and evaluates tool selection, arguments, execution order, and database integrity through programmatic checks and a narrowly scoped LLM judge. We evaluate 240 trials across two skills, two specification variants, two agent harnesses, and three models. Of 175 trials passing all applicable final numerical checks, 162 (92.6 percent; Wilson 95 percent CI: 87.7-95.6 percent) contained another evaluator-detected deviation. tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合结果级与过程级检查的持续评估框架，能够检测出最终输出评估所遗漏的过程级行为漂移——在通过全部最终数值检查的试验中，仍有92.6%存在其他评估器发现的偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a continuous evaluation framework combining outcome-level and process-level checks for evolving enterprise AI agent skills, revealing that 92.6% of trials passing all final numerical checks still contained evaluator-detected process-level deviations missed by final-output evaluation.
